items.title: ARC-032 theta-bypass DIRECT readout: z_goal persistence + goal-proximity-score noise at E3-tick granularity (redesign of 228b)
items.note: Redesign of V3-EXQ-228b per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-228b_2026-08-09. 228b was the FIRST run in the 076/228/247/228a/228b lineage to clear ARC-032's non-degeneracy precondition (goal_norm 1.00 frac seeds), theta-patch confirmed non-inert, but its resource-lift readout FAILED with two measurement-adequacy defects the autopsy would not accept as falsifying: (a) E3-tick cache-gating dilutes any theta-specific signal ~9x in a full-episode aggregate; (b) the driver measured a downstream behavioral proxy, never claims.yaml's own CONFIRMING DVs (z_goal persistence, goal-proximity-score noise). 228c keeps 228b's proven shared-training/deepcopy-split THETA_ACTIVE-vs-THETA_ZEROED architecture BYTE-IDENTICAL and changes ONLY the measurement: scores z_goal persistence (lag-1 cosine of z_goal) and goal-proximity-score noise (temporal std of the lead candidate's goal_proximity) DIRECTLY, restricted to E3-tick steps where the ablation acts. Behavioral resource-lift kept informational. GOV-REUSE-1: the E3-tick-restricted persistence/noise readouts are NOT recorded in 228b's manifest (which recorded only full-episode resource_visit_rate/harm_rate/zgoal_norm_mean) and are not derivable by reanalysis -> genuine new run. Re-derive brake: does NOT fire (ARC-032 counted-ceiling count=1 < 2; and this is a measurement_test_design_defect redesign, action:none, not a substrate-ceiling power-bump). DV-symmetry: both DVs are genuinely sensitive to zeroing theta (not arithmetic invariants) -- persistence via the behavioral->benefit->z_goal loop, proximity-noise via the proposer's z_world_for_e3 input (smoke confirms C2 differs between arms: 0.0216 vs 0.0342). Reversed direction (theta ACTIVE worse) is registered as a finding (converges with MECH-089 EXQ-066/EXQ-122 that static theta-averaging harms E3 discrimination), NOT dismissed. Runs under known substrate_queue defect SD-E3-SCORER-COMPLETION (severity: degrading, e3_selector.py). Prefer cloud (228b ran on ree-worker-3, ~221 min).

items.title: MECH-025: action-doing mode DV redesign (C1 sign reversed per Thura & Cisek 2014 convergence; precision-ratio demoted to non-gating descriptive metric)
items.note: Finishes the routing from the confirmed failure_autopsy_mech025-cluster-876-671b_2026-08-03 (chip-20260808-mech025-doing-mode-dv-redesign; 5+ days unqueued). V3-EXQ-876 was the first fair V3 test of MECH-025 (all 3 prior instrument defects fixed, both regimes well-sampled/non-degenerate in every seed) but its C1 criterion (doing_mode_delta > 0.002) FAILed with the OPPOSITE sign in 4/5 seeds; autopsy classified this measurement_test_design_defect/non_contributory because the claim's own cited literature disputes C1's sign convention (Friston 2013: precision is continuous, not a discrete mode switch -- flags C1's whole discrete-split framing as a formal-import mismatch; Thura & Cisek 2014, Neuron, the closer biological reference: PMd/M1 representations CONVERGE, not diverge, during commitment -- predicting a SMALLER causal-signature contrast under commitment, i.e. the negative delta V3-EXQ-876 actually observed). claims.yaml's what_would_answer (2026-08-08 digestion) offered two redesign directions: (1) flip C1's sign per Thura-Cisek, or (2) gate on precision_committed_mean vs precision_uncommitted_mean directly (already recorded in 876, separating 4-5 orders of magnitude every seed, never scored). THIS SCRIPT TAKES (1) AS THE LOAD-BEARING CRITERION AND DEMOTES (2) TO NON-GATING: E3's commit rule is LITERALLY committed=running_variance<threshold, precision=1/variance, so 'committed steps have higher precision' is a near-tautological consequence of the substrate's OWN definition of commitment (ARC-016, already independently stable/validated), not an independently falsifiable prediction of MECH-025 -- gating on it risks a structurally-guaranteed vacuous_pass. Direction (1)'s causal_sig, by contrast, is computed from two genuinely independent E2.world_forward rollouts (actual vs a distinct randomly-sampled counterfactual action) through E3.harm_eval and is not wired to the commit rule's own variance computation at all (DV-symmetry: not a broadcast constant, not a monotone rescale of a shared upstream quantity -- see module docstring for the full declaration). GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): reanalysis_query.py --readout precision_committed_mean --claim MECH-025 found exactly ONE compatible manifest (v3_exq_876_..._20260802T214005Z_v3, substrate_hash 5bba8a67...) and its doing_mode_delta values are ALREADY KNOWN to this authoring session (negative in 4/5 seeds) -- reusing/reanalyzing that same data under a reversed-sign criterion would be circular (HARKing) regardless of whether done via a formal reanalysis or a relabeled rerun. NOT reused: this script runs FRESH SEEDS (11,17,29,53,71 -- disjoint from 876's [42,123,7,99,256]; none is 44, the documented reef-config instability seed) through the UNCHANGED, already-validated instrument (same SelectionResult.committed read, same agent.update_residue()-every-tick call, same BreathOscillator config) so the reversed criterion is tested against genuinely new data. C1's magnitude (0.002) is carried over UNCHANGED from 876's own pre-registered bar (only the sign flips) -- not fit to the observed effect sizes (-0.03 to -0.09, ~10-40x larger), leaving real room for the fresh run to fail too. RECORDING FIX: 876's write_flat_manifest(...,config=None,...) gap (flagged in the autopsy) is fixed here (full REEConfig passed via dataclasses.asdict, started_at wired for elapsed_seconds, z_goal_stream_stats via ZGoalStreamAccumulator). Re-derive brake (2.5b): 0 substrate_ceiling autopsies tag MECH-025 (the one confirmed autopsy is measurement_test_design_defect, action=none) -- not braked. Substrate readiness (2.5): ARC-016 stable/V3-confirmed (dynamic E3 precision), all 6 depends_on claims unblocked, confirmed via claims.yaml + ree-v3/CLAUDE.md ARC-016 sections. Substrate-path overlap gate (2.5c): no open corrupting substrate_queue.json entries with substrate_paths set at all. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 warnings across every category. Smoke PASS (--dry-run, seed 11, 5/3/30 toy schedule): ran clean, no crash, correct P0-unready self-route at toy scale (expected, not load-bearing), progress lines (ep N/M) + verdict line + precision_ratio all emit correctly. Landed via a throwaway worktree at origin/main (shared ree-v3 checkout dirty with other sessions' live WIP + concurrent phase3-queue snapshot writers -- first rebase attempt hit a merge conflict against an intervening snapshot commit, resolved by re-forking a fresh worktree off the newer origin/main tip rather than hand-resolving JSON conflict markers). items.title: MECH-357 freeze-incompatible Stage-H: mobile predators reintroduce the Pavlovian-instrumental conflict; 3-arm two-sided headroom guard (successor of 603r)
items.note: Freeze-incompatible successor of V3-EXQ-603r per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-603r_2026-08-09. 603r's combined-fix rerun FAILED discrimination because the harm-pathway fix alone made passive PAG freeze/release survival-adequate in the STATIC Stage-H field, eliminating the Pavlovian-instrumental conflict Moscarello & LeDoux's active-avoidance paradigm needs (reclassified measurement_test_design_defect / non_contributory; NOT a MECH-357 weakens). 603s adds the autopsy-recommended freeze-incompatible pressure via MOBILE PREDATORS: exposes new scaffold knobs scaffold_hazard_stage_env_drift_interval/_prob (defaults 5/0.3 == env defaults, bit-identical for all prior consumers) and sets interval=1/prob=0.6 so fast-drifting hazards sweep the non-reef grid -- an undirected freeze/release policy is overrun in place while a directed escape-to-reef policy survives (reef stays a hazard-exclusion refuge under drift; verified 0 violations this session). Env-mechanics audit ruled OUT starvation (no energy->health death) and agent-directed pursuit (not in env; would be /implement-substrate) as config-buildable, leaving mobile-predators as the buildable freeze-incompatible lever. 3 arms x 3 seeds [42,43,44] with a TWO-SIDED discriminative-headroom guard (the check the 603h-floor/603r-ceiling history showed no existing flag tests): ARM_LESION (negative control) must now FAIL the gate (headroom below); ARM_POSCTRL (gated + reef spawn, positive control) must CLEAR it (survivability above). Mis-calibrated mobility self-routes to pressure_insufficient_requeue (LESION ceilinged) or pressure_impossible_requeue (POSCTRL floored), NOT a false verdict. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (G_H_LESION + INTACT-beats-LESION under a MOBILE-PREDATOR field) is a NEW manipulation absent from every recorded run (603r/603h ran env_drift 5/0.3) -> not reanalysis-recoverable, ran fresh. Re-derive brake: does NOT fire (0 prior substrate_ceiling autopsies tag MECH-357; 603r is measurement_test_design_defect/non_contributory). Substrate-overlap gate: no open corrupting substrate_queue entry overlaps scaffolded_sd054_onboarding.py or causal_grid_world.py. Also re-instruments MECH-357's avoidance_efficacy credit event per-episode (avoidance_efficacy_trajectory), still 'essentially inert' since 603h. Smoke PASS; full contract suite run on cloud.
